name: Algebra 1 Practice Course Profile
role: Course-specific Practice behavior for the canonical family-Bank architecture. Practice artifacts are generated downstream as fresh instances; Practice 2/3 are retired.
question_structure_rule: Use current universal Question Structure for every authored Practice question. Blooket is the explicit selected-response game exception.

bank_relationship.architecture: Mastery Goal -> I Can -> Question Family
bank_relationship.mastery_use: Use current Unit Bank family architecture for the section Mastery strand and author fresh instances.
bank_relationship.intro_review_use: Intro/Review are owned by the exact Unit Assessment Plan and may reference goals from other Units. Future/other Unit Banks are optional architecture references, never blocking dependencies.

extra_practice.purpose: Recovery + alternate representation + extension/transfer; not a numeric clone of Practice 1.

cyu.layout: existing two-column CYU grid + separate workspace page
cyu.stage_display: put .practice-stage-tag inside each question rather than separate stage sections

tarsia.format: one comma-separated question,answer pair per line
tarsia.rule: Text-friendly, unique/unambiguous matches; fresh instances; not Practice 3.

blooket.rule: Plausible misconception distractors, one defensible correct answer, fresh text-friendly instances; not Practice 3.

minimum_surfaces: all earlier outputs in the same Practice build
already-built student-facing same-section artifacts when present
